contract.purpose: PostTrainLLM turns bounded local model experiments into measured, reproducible specialist packages on one Apple Silicon Mac.
contract.purposeSource: Site Health dossier, AGENTS.md, PRODUCT.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, factory public artifacts, and current model cards
contract.canonicalPurpose: A local research factory for training, evaluating, packaging, and understanding useful specialist language models.
contract.audience: Practitioners who want to build and evaluate bounded specialist language models on personal Apple hardware without a cloud training platform.
contract.job: Understand the native factory loop, inspect current specialist evidence and limitations, then run the source quickstart on a Mac.
contract.thesis: A specialist earns a routed ship decision only when target gains, breadth regressions, missing measurements, packaging, and reproducibility are reported together.
contract.system: The established dark teal-and-coral Local Research Bench system, with a loss-curve signature, technical typography, restrained cards, and evidence-first responsive document flow.
contract.signature: The target-data-post-train-eval-package-decision loop connects the hero promise to the current ReST package, exact scorecard, honest scope, and native factory action.
contract.risk: Historical browser, pretraining, and systems benchmarks could be mistaken for proof of the current specialist, so the page separates the tiny browser learning demo and presents only package-specific evidence in the current proof band.

answers.product: PostTrainLLM is a Mac-local research factory for building, evaluating, packaging, and inspecting bounded specialist language models.
answers.audience: Practitioners who want reproducible specialist-model work on personal Apple Silicon hardware.
answers.value: It turns experiments into explicit routed ship, retry, redirect, or reject decisions with the regressions and missing evidence attached.
answers.mechanism: A target-data-post-train-eval-package-report loop emits a schema-valid factory run and public specialist scorecard.
answers.proof: The page presents the current qwen3-4b-rest-fused package with a 100 percent file-operations gate at n=12, 65 percent held-out breadth at n=52, published HF and MLX weights, and explicit missing runtime traces.
answers.nextAction: Run the native factory quickstart or inspect the current specialist scorecard and limits.
